title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Demonstrate strong knowledge and expertise in scripting languages and contribute to the development and enhancement of test automation scripts Proficient in creating, modifying, and reviewing test plans and test cases Efficiently set up test beds tailored to specific test plans and scenarios Execute test cases meticulously, identifying, documenting, and reporting issues Provide detailed test execution results and update the metrics by contributing to the continuous improvement of product quality Collaborate closely with developers to identify the RCA for the issues by reproduction and joint debugging (as appropriate) Contribute to the evolution and implementation of automated testing strategies Requirements Proficiency in scripting languages, specifically Python or Bash Knowledge and experience with test automation frameworks – py ATS, Cypress, Robot Frameworks Experience with API based testing, UI Automation Solid understanding of technology / protocols for domains
